people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
translations.bsb: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘If anyone curses his God, he shall bear the consequences of his sin.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
translations.asv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.
